subject: Math
prompt: Two parallel lines are intersected by a third line. One of the angles formed measures $115°$. Angle $x$ is supplementary to this $115°$ angle. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle $x$?
explanation: When two angles are supplementary, their measures sum to $180°$. Since angle $x$ is supplementary to $115°$, angle $x$ measures $180° - 115° = 65°$.
